note: The A tier and the B tier of one family share this contract, so their goldens and case generators stay interchangeable.
input: x of shape (B, S, C), not pre-split Q/K/V
projections: one fused in-projection to 3C, split into q/k/v; the reference defines an out-projection but never applies it, so the output keeps the head layout
mask: causal, top-left, applied before the activation
activation: ReLU on the masked scores, in place of Softmax
normalisation: none: there is no denominator, so the output is a plain weighted sum
determinism: no dropout anywhere, so the reference is deterministic
causal_mask_buffer: the reference precomputes a (max_seqlen, max_seqlen) tril buffer; input length equals max_seqlen in every case
